title: 해양경찰위원회 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:9:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text: Article 9 (Detailed Rules of Operation) Matters necessary for the operation of the Committee and related matters other than those prescribed in this Decree shall be determined by the chairperson following a resolution of the Committee.
